guide.comecar.t1.title: What is where
guide.comecar.t2.body: The Desk connects the tutor when it opens and when you switch courses. If it does not answer, the column says why and offers Call again and the way to the tutor program settings.
guide.comecar.t2.title: The tutor connects on its own
guide.comecar.t3.body: Folders, course names and the path of the tutor program are in Settings. The theme (automatic, light or dark), the accent color and Compact mode (⌘⇧D) are in the Appearance and notices section.
guide.comecar.t3.title: Folders, courses and appearance
guide.comecar.t4.body: The GeoGebra tab holds the built-in applet. While it is open, the tutor can drive the applet and read the construction, and ⌘⇧G sends it a screenshot to check (the model must accept images). The construction is remembered per course.
guide.comecar.t4.title: GeoGebra
guide.lateral.t1.body: From the button in the tutor header, even with a single reader. The second reader (Formula sheet) collapses from the Study menu and comes back from the strip that stays in its place, without losing document, page or draft.
guide.lateral.t1.title: Where it opens
guide.lateral.t2.body: It starts with a snapshot of the main session, the open PDFs and the active question. Refresh context copies the current snapshot again; resuming the session does not renew it by itself.
guide.lateral.t2.title: Copied context

guide.leitores.t1.body: Limits.pdf, p. 3 in an answer opens the PDF at that page (or loads the file in the reader). Back, in the reader bar, undoes the jump; Browse keeps named bookmarks and shows the document's outline.
guide.leitores.t1.title: Clickable citation
guide.leitores.t2.body: ⌘F searches the focused PDF: it scans every page, highlights each match and counts them; Search again goes to the next one and Esc clears.
guide.leitores.t2.title: Search
guide.leitores.t3.body: The three dots in each reader's bar hold zoom, fit to width, Invert colors (the choice is kept per file), rotate, Capture page and minimize the PDF into a strip that frees the space for the other one; click the strip to restore.
guide.leitores.t3.title: Reader options
guide.leitores.t4.body: Wheel or trackpad scroll the pages in sequence; <kbd>⌘</kbd> + wheel or pinch zooms; <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> change the focused PDF's page.
guide.leitores.t4.title: Moving through the document
guide.leitores.t5.body: Drop a PDF on the reader to open the file from where it is, without copying. With no material, the reader shows the getting-started sheet.
guide.leitores.t5.title: Drop a PDF

guide.revisao.t2.body: In the Review notebook, in the Study menu, each item due today asks for an answer. Missed comes back tomorrow; Hard, Good and Easy come back more and more spaced out. Each button says when the item comes back.
guide.revisao.t2.title: How did it go?

guide.tutor.t1.title: What goes along
guide.tutor.t2.body: Captures the Xournal++ window and puts it in the attachment tray, one image per capture. Nothing is sent until you write and send. Do you write in another program? In Settings → Folders and programs, the Writing program field has Choose…, which lists the open windows (the action palette also leads there with Choose another window…); the Desk remembers the program and the button is named after it. On macOS the system may ask for Screen Recording; on Windows the capture uses the system's own PowerShell.
guide.tutor.t2.title: Check Xournal++
guide.tutor.t3.body: Sending during an answer queues the message; it goes out as soon as the tutor finishes, and the queue is saved if you close the Desk. ⌘⏎ interrupts and sends now. Esc stops the answer and holds the queue: Send now or Clear in the strip.
guide.tutor.t3.title: Write while it answers
guide.tutor.t4.body: With the Attach button, by pasting (⌘V) or by dragging onto the message. The model must accept images. For the tutor to see the whole page, use Capture page in the reader's More options.
guide.tutor.t4.title: Attach images
guide.tutor.t5.body: Select a passage from the session or from a PDF's text and click Quote to ask about it. Formulas go in as LaTeX; PDF passages are quoted with the file name and page.
guide.tutor.t5.title: Quote a passage
guide.tutor.t6.body: They are in the indicator in the tutor header, for example Sonnet · medium. Click it to change. Each session keeps the engine that created it; to open one in Claude (experimental, uses the login made in Claude Code itself), use the action palette (⌘K) → New session with Claude (experimental).
guide.tutor.t6.title: Model and effort
guide.tutor.t7.body: The session title, in the tutor header, lists the course's sessions; choosing from there keeps the draft, queue and attachments. More options has the context meter, Summarize now and automatic compaction. Typing /compact in the message does the same (it accepts instructions: /compact focus on question 7).
guide.tutor.t7.title: Sessions and context
guide.tutor.t8.body: In the tutor's More options. It saves the course's local log — where you stopped, the next step, the question, the pages and the .xopp — and only then tells the tutor; without the tutor the log is the same. The next time you open the course, the column says where you stopped: Resume restores question, page and draft; New session opens another and keeps the log; Forget only deletes the log.
guide.tutor.t8.title: End for today
guide.tutor.t9.body: Hover a message for Copy, or use Export session as Markdown in More options. Quizzes appear as cards: click the answer, or mark several and send. Charts and diagrams the tutor generates appear in the session; click the image to enlarge. Visualizations (charts, tables, diagrams) and interactive activities appear loose in the session, with no frame: hover to see Full screen (Esc exits); in an activity, Bring to the tutor puts your attempt in the draft without sending. Code blocks have highlighting and a copy button.
guide.tutor.t9.title: In the answers
